name: Pale Choir
description: A hot white star with a giant attended by three moons singing in orbital resonance. The trojan swarm at the giant's Lagrange points holds the system's shipyards. Everything here runs on schedule, including the aurorae.

stars.name: Choir Light
stars.description: A fast-spinning white star whose clean light flatters every world it touches. It rotates in under a day, flattening almost visibly. Its habitable zone is broad and still mostly empty.

planets.name: Canticle
planets.description: A ringed giant with three large moons locked in a four-two-one resonance that rings like a bell. Tidal heating keeps the middle moon's ocean liquid. The shipyards ride the trojan points fore and aft.

moons.name: Treble
moons.description: The innermost singer, volcanic from resonance tides, resurfacing yearly. Sulfur frost paints the high ground between glowing rifts. Observation posts watch the eruptions on rotation.

moons.name: Alto
moons.description: A cracked ice moon with a buried sea, middle voice of the resonance. Plumes vent along tiger stripes at the south pole. Sample missions queue for every launch window.

moons.name: Bass
moons.description: A dark ancient moon keeping the outer beat, cratered beyond counting. Its dead calm anchors the resonance mathematics. Deep archives sleep in its lava tubes.

planets.name: Antiphon
planets.description: A slate-blue ice giant answering Canticle across the outer dark. Its faint rings tilt at an odd angle nobody has explained. Methane storms drift in slow stately bands.

belts.name: Choir Trojans
belts.description: Twin swarms riding Canticle's Lagrange points, rich in volatiles and metals. Shipyard frames grow in the stable gravity wells. Traffic control here is the strictest in the arm.
